bio: Buy gift vouchers for Afternoon Tea for Two at one of the Harvey Nichols locations across the UK. Head to London - Knightsbridge, Edinburgh or Bristol to enjoy this quintessentially British dining treat for two in the stylish settings of the refined store.  Relax and enjoy a selection of savoury treats and delicate sandwiches as well as miniature cakes and pastries, all beautifully presented. It wouldn't be Afternoon Tea without the addition of homemade scones served with fresh cream and Harvey Nichols preserves alongside handpicked teas, coffees and infusions - all served with a Harvey Nichols signature twist!   Gift vouchers are valid for two people  Available week round, year round  Menus may vary at each Harvey Nichols stores and are subject to change  Any additional items not included in the experience will be charged separately on the day of the visit and a discretionary 11.5% service charge will be added to the dining bill  Please inform the venue of any dietary requirements upon booking  All dates are subject to availability
